title: Bohurupi
desc: A traveling performer makes money by pretending to be demons for fun. However, after a wonderful dream, his mind completely changes.

title: Sharthopor
desc: Aparna and Saurav's once close relationship begins to unravel as the shadow of family property disputes and emotional pride threatens to break their lifelong bond.

title: 100 Percent Love
desc: Competitive peers Balu and Mahalakshmi have ego clashes while in college. When they meet again after a few years, they try to outdo each other until they realise that they are in love.

title: Takkar
desc: Chaitali, a rich girl, marries Arun against her family's wishes. Soon, their relationship turns sour and the bone of contention between the couple is the man's nephew.

title: Baba Keno Chakar
desc: When Rajnarayan asks his son to help out with the expenses for his sister's wedding, he refuses. As a result, he is forced to go from pillar to post to make ends meet.
